historical_input_archive.relationship: The 27 selected operators are a subset of this 33-case historical clean precision-failure input archive; all selected wrapper/kernel/reference bytes independently match the later frozen paper manifest.

exclusions: Historical model transcripts and execution logs
Provider settings, credentials and machine configuration
Post-paper CANNBench optimization code and knowledge assets
validation_boundary: File identity, task structure and case descriptors are checked without importing candidate/reference programs or running a model, compiler or NPU. Historical failure labels describe the source archive, not a fresh evaluation.
